title: Kickin Peppery Mexican Pork Cochinita Pibil
description: A peppery and flavorful Mexican dish featuring jasmine rice and pork, perfect for a sick day, and is Whole30-friendly. This cochinita pibil recipe is a bouncy and delicious meal option.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, whisk together black pepper, cumin, coriander, and salt.
Rub the spice mixture all over the pork shoulder, making sure to coat it evenly.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the pork shoulder until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Add the lime juice to the Dutch oven and bring to a simmer.
Cover the Dutch oven with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the pork for 2 1/2 hours, or until tender and easily shredded.
While the pork is cooking, prepare the jasmine rice according to package instructions.
Shred the pork with two forks and serve with the cooked jasmine rice.
